Warehouse Supervisor (2nd Shift) | Columbus, OH | $24–$28/hr + shift differential

Northgate Distribution is hiring a Warehouse Supervisor for our 300,000 sq ft e-commerce fulfillment center. You'll lead a team of 25–40 associates across receiving, picking, packing and shipping, run shift start-up meetings, track productivity against KPIs and make sure every order leaves on time.

Qualifications: 2+ years of supervisory experience in a warehouse or distribution environment; working knowledge of a warehouse management system (Manhattan, Blue Yonder or SAP EWM); intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP); OSHA safety standards; forklift certification or ability to obtain within 30 days; available Monday–Friday 2:30pm–11:00pm with overtime as needed. No degree required. Lean / Six Sigma Yellow Belt, OSHA 30 or bilingual English/Spanish are a plus.

Perks: weekly pay, medical/dental/vision from day one, 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement, on-site gym.

Northgate Distribution is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.
